summary.text: Sharon Renier, a U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 5th District to Tim Walberg.
She advanced from the party's convention on July 18, 2026, and previously sought the Republican nomination for the Michigan House of Representatives.
She received 0.9% of the vote to Tim Walberg's 59.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
